results.title: The GLA Roads Designation Order 2000 (UKSI 2000-1117).pdf
results.desc: Section 260 of the Greater London Authority Act 1999 inserts a new section 14A into the Highways Act 1980 whereby the Secretary of State may designate highways or proposed highways which are to be GLA roads, for which Transport for London will be the highway authority. This Order designates the highways specified in the Schedule as GLA roads with effect from 3rd July 2000.
